faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Removing Objects
faq.intro: Learn how selection masks, shared credits, supported files, and private processing work.

items.question: How do I remove an object from a photo?
items.answer: Upload or paste an image, paint over the unwanted object with Brush or trace it with Lasso, then select Remove object. Compare the AI result with the original and download the PNG.

items.question: Should the blue mask cover the entire object?
items.answer: Yes. Cover the full object and include a small margin around its edges. A complete mask gives AI enough context to reconstruct the area cleanly.

items.question: What can I remove?
items.answer: The tool can help remove people, signs, text, small items, product-photo clutter, and other visible distractions. Results vary with the object's size and the complexity of the background.

items.question: Is the AI object remover free?
items.answer: You can try it with your WatermarkGemini free balance. Object removal, watermark removal, and background removal share the same initial free use and daily check-in rewards.

items.question: Which image formats are supported?
items.answer: You can upload JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, and JFIF images up to 10 MB. The completed result is available as a PNG.

items.question: Can I fix a mask before processing?
items.answer: Yes. Switch to Eraser to remove excess paint, use Undo to restore the previous selection, or Clear the whole mask and start again.

items.question: What happens to my uploaded image and mask?
items.answer: The original image, generated mask, and result are stored privately and are designed to expire after 24 hours. Provider credentials and private storage keys never reach the browser.

items.question: Can I upload any image?
items.answer: Only upload images you own or are authorized to edit. Do not use the tool to violate copyright, privacy, trademark, or other rights, and avoid confidential material.
